mode: built-in image_gen illustrations with deterministic PNG cutout and text composition

variants.blank: No copy or numbers; screenshot slots use actual alpha transparency.
variants.copy: Traditional Chinese copy with visible glyph bounds centered inside each designated color band; screenshot slots remain transparent.

insertion: Place actual webpage screenshots on a layer BELOW the template PNG; paired blank/copy versions share identical alpha masks. Preserve screenshots aspect ratios and crop them to the slot as needed.

Use case: ads-marketing / compositing background. Create a lively, fully art-directed illustrated APP feature poster BACKGROUND for FreshWise / 菜鳥買菜記, LANDSCAPE 16:9. Final canvas is 3200 by 1800.
INPUT IMAGE ROLES: Image 1 is the REQUIRED layout template, preserve the exact positions, sizes, orientation and solid saturated fill colors of ALL cyan, magenta and blue rectangles; these are technical color-key inserts for REAL WEBPAGE SCREENSHOTS placed later. Image 2 is the user's desired rich, playful style reference: match its cheerful garden scene, warm thick cocoa outlines, warm cream paper, honey wood, lime/sage foliage, peach accents, bold cute props and large smiling cabbage pet. Freshly draw everything in one consistent hand, smooth medium-thick contours, soft watercolor pencil paper grain, no mixed line weights.
DESIGN: Large cabbage pet on the lower right, around x2500–3150 y1000–1770. A hanging wooden series sign upper-right. Three large illustrated feature icons at x100–370 centered y840,1150,1460: produce cluster / produce basket / watering can. Leafy green/yellow brush bands behind feature headlines, peach ribbon behind subtitle. Garden, greenhouse, picket fence, white daisies and gingham corners fill outer edges.
All coordinates below refer to the final 3200x1800 canvas. Every light cream strip in the layout is an area for crisply typeset text added later. KEEP THOSE COPY AREAS LIGHT, EMPTY AND LEGIBLE; add leaf brush swashes / illustrated ribbons BEHIND these areas, but NO lettering. Reserve headlines near (160,150), font height about 52; (145,440), font height about 180; (240,620), font height about 57; (440,855), font height about 64; (440,941), font height about 44.8. Large feature illustrations live BESIDE text areas, not on top of text. Fill remaining edge and corner gaps with garden scenery, pets, produce, decorative wood, cloth, leaves and flowers much like the style reference. Do not make a minimalist blank stationery background. The final result should feel full, animated and fun while copy stays readable.
CRITICAL INSERT INVARIANTS: CYAN solid color rectangle at x=1570, y=120, width=820, height=1660. Leave the insides of these colored areas completely FLAT, SOLID, SATURATED and EMPTY in exactly their existing color. Frame their OUTSIDES in illustrated paper/wood. No color wash or shading inside color-key areas. Keep ALL frames axis-aligned, no perspective or tilt, do not reduce slot sizes or move them. Pet/flowers may overlap ONLY a small outer frame edge. Never copy or redraw app UI from image 2. NO fake UI, NO charts, NO fields or buttons, NO Chinese/English text, NO numbers, NO symbols resembling letters. Text and real screenshot pixels will be composed after generation. No logos or watermarks. Maintain the template canvas aspect ratio exactly.
